items.behavior: The served surfaces are /, /index.php, /tv.php, /admin-arena.php, /report.php and the Arena play entry; the classic /game.php, /main.php, /wall.php and /join.php routes were retired on purpose and answer 404.
items.referenceEvidence: evidence/original-public manifest and captured HTML pages (index.php, main.php, wall.php, game/station-1..3.html, admin.php).
items.implementationEvidence: src/web/pages/index.mjs renders only the surviving surfaces and rejects the retired routes; the classic copy stays frozen in evidence/original-public.
items.knownDifference: The classic player, main and wall pages are no longer served (main.php's collective screen became /tv.php); the capture remains the record of the classic copy.
items.decision: Score the surviving surfaces and the frozen capture; never restore a classic route just to satisfy a test.

items.behavior: Public visual/runtime assets preserve the captured base where intentionally retained.
items.referenceEvidence: evidence/original-public/manifest.json SHA-256 records; package/source correlation audit.
items.implementationEvidence: public/assets contains preserved and adapted runtime assets.
items.knownDifference: Some executable branding and runtime JS were intentionally adapted.
items.decision: Classify byte-identical assets individually; do not claim the whole executable asset tree is identical.

items.behavior: Browser-facing API actions and fields match the public app.js contract.

items.implementationEvidence: src/server/api.mjs implements register, heartbeat, room_status, start_match, match_status, submit_prompt, retry_score, client_log and metrics.
items.knownDifference: Backend internals are reimplemented.
items.decision: Freeze names and semantics used by the captured JS.

items.behavior: Three classic stations register before play with LGPD acceptance.
items.referenceEvidence: captured game station HTML and app.js registration flow.
items.implementationEvidence: src/server/api.mjs classic registration uses three fixed stations and consent validation.
items.knownDifference: Internal session persistence differs.
items.decision: Preserve observable classic registration sequence.

items.behavior: Heartbeat is 2500 ms and visible state synchronization follows the original cadence without perceptible skips.
items.referenceEvidence: captured app.js heartbeat/timer constants and polling flow.
items.implementationEvidence: current app.js uses SSE plus polling fallback.
items.knownDifference: SSE is an internal optimization not present in the capture.
items.decision: Keep SSE only if classic visible timing remains equivalent.

items.behavior: Classic flow idle -> registration -> ready -> playing -> scoring -> results/final_results -> idle.
items.referenceEvidence: captured app.js plus live room_status observation from 2026-09-04.
items.implementationEvidence: src/domain/game-state.mjs and src/server/api.mjs implement the same observable phases; AALpy inferred a 13-state Mealy model over the bounded macro alphabet.
items.knownDifference: Internal transition ownership is server-side and more explicit.
items.decision: Preserve the initial idle phase, visible phase order and deadlines.

items.behavior: 3 players, 3 rounds, 60 s round, 10 s round result, 30 s final result; timer ticks around 250 ms.
items.referenceEvidence: captured station HTML data attributes and app.js.
items.implementationEvidence: GAME_RULES currently encode 3/3/60/10/30.
items.knownDifference: SSE can make state discovery faster than polling.
items.decision: Freeze phase durations exactly and audit client tick/poll cadence separately.

items.behavior: Prompt submission is single-shot, server-scored, and returned through match/room state.
items.referenceEvidence: captured app.js submit_prompt payload and response handling.
items.implementationEvidence: src/server/api.mjs stores submission, judges it and exposes match state.
items.knownDifference: Implementation adds stronger idempotency auditing.
items.decision: Keep improvements only when duplicate-visible behavior is unchanged.

items.behavior: Historical Gemini path uses gemini-2.0-flash, temperature 0.1, maxOutputTokens 10 and 8 s timeout before fallback.
items.referenceEvidence: user-supplied batalha_prompt.zip api.php; research/red-door-judge package audit; deployed asset correlation.
items.implementationEvidence: src/judge/source-compatible-judge.mjs and JUDGE_MODE=gemini bootstrap.
items.knownDifference: Cannot prove the private deployed PHP was byte-identical to the supplied package.
items.decision: Call this source-compatible, not private-backend identical.

items.behavior: Historical package fallback uses 40% PHP similar_text compatibility + 60% keyword coverage; the current live fallback returned 20% for a case where that historical rule returns 11.7221%.
items.referenceEvidence: batalha_prompt.zip api.php and three SQLite fixtures; isolated live match 4981 captured on 2026-09-04.
items.implementationEvidence: src/judge/fake-judge.mjs reproduces the historical package fixtures, while the live divergence remains explicitly tracked.
items.knownDifference: Current live fallback has changed or applies an additional floor/normalization not proven by one sample.
items.decision: Do not claim current-live fallback equivalence until additional independent live observations distinguish the candidate formulas.

items.behavior: Pending Gemini scoring can be retried without double-scoring; historical package itself falls back on direct Gemini failure.
items.referenceEvidence: captured app.js retry_score behavior and package api.php fallback path.
items.implementationEvidence: src/server/api.mjs retry_score is idempotent; source-compatible judge falls back internally.
items.knownDifference: Audit trail is richer in the implementation.
items.decision: Ensure retry never recalculates a finalized score.

items.behavior: Current live points fit round(percent * 100 + remaining_time_ratio * 1000); an empty timeout is forced to zero.
items.referenceEvidence: isolated live matches 4981 and 4982 captured on 2026-09-04: 20%, 47/60 s => 2217 points; empty timeout => 0.
items.implementationEvidence: src/domain/scoring.mjs implements the observed speed bonus and src/server/api.mjs preserves the zero timeout boundary.
items.knownDifference: The supplied historical package had no speed bonus; only one non-timeout live point sample is currently available.
items.decision: Prefer current live behavior over the historical package, but retain INFERRED until multiple independent points observations confirm the coefficients.

items.behavior: Round ranking sorts by points, then percent, then lower elapsed time.
items.referenceEvidence: captured ranking fields/text and preserved audit conclusions.
items.implementationEvidence: src/domain/ranking.mjs rankRound uses points, percent, elapsed.
items.knownDifference: Full original backend tie implementation was not directly captured.
items.decision: Keep tie logic explicit and label as inferred until direct source/capture proves it.

items.behavior: Final ranking accumulates total_points and avg_percent with time as final tie criterion.
items.referenceEvidence: captured app.js final ranking fields and package/report behavior.
items.implementationEvidence: src/server/api.mjs aggregates scores and rankFinal orders totals.
items.knownDifference: Original private aggregation implementation is not directly visible.
items.decision: Freeze observed field semantics and avoid claiming private implementation identity.

items.behavior: Higher points, then accuracy, then lower time; exact ties share a position.
items.referenceEvidence: captured/public wording and preserved audit; private exact tie branch unavailable.
items.implementationEvidence: src/domain/ranking.mjs uses this order and stable station ordering for display.
items.knownDifference: Exact-tie presentation by the original backend is not fully observed.
items.decision: Add explicit exact-tie regression and retain INFERRED unless stronger evidence appears.

items.behavior: Reload restores session and authoritative match/room state.
items.referenceEvidence: captured app.js localStorage/server reset/session recovery logic.
items.implementationEvidence: SQLite state plus session identifiers and status endpoints reconstruct current state.
items.test: test/api/multiplayer-flow.test.mjs plus planned classic recovery test
items.knownDifference: Implementation persistence mechanism differs.
items.decision: Judge equivalence by returned state after reload, not storage technology.

items.behavior: An empty timeout is recorded at the authoritative deadline with gemini_status timeout_empty, zero percent, zero points, no fallback and the live feedback text.
items.referenceEvidence: isolated live match 4982 captured on 2026-09-04.
items.implementationEvidence: src/server/api.mjs bypasses the judge for blank timeout and publishes the same observable result.
items.knownDifference: Only the empty-timeout branch has direct live evidence; non-empty timeout remains unobserved.
items.decision: Freeze the proven empty-timeout branch and keep non-empty timeout as an uncovered subcase.
